title: Concept
description: Frontmatter of a concept file plus its SEE-I body, as one object. The capture tools' inputs and outputs are defined in docs/design/api/capture-tools.schema.json. Stored per ADR-002: YAML frontmatter holds every field except seeI; the body holds seeI under the headings '## Statement', '## Elaboration', '## Example', '## Illustration'. A visual illustration (ADR-009) is the file illustrations/<id>.svg next to the concept files, referenced only by one Markdown image link inside the Illustration part (seeI.illustration); there is no frontmatter field for it, and a concept is complete without it (NFR-004).

pictogram.description: Optional id of a library pictogram (BR-008, ADR-009). Membership in the library is checked by the rules module, not by this schema; a missing or unknown id shows the layer's pictogram (FR-038).

illustration.description: May contain one Markdown image link to illustrations/<concept id>.svg (BR-008, ADR-009); the text stays required.

to.description: Must be an existing concept id (BR-001); checked by the rules module, not by this schema.

id.description: Stable within the concept; the review log refers to '<concept id>#<id>'. Never reused.

confirmed.description: Local calendar day the author confirmed the question; written by capture, never edited. Starting point of the Leitner replay: box 1, due the next day (FR-030).
